item.tib: mkha' 'gro shes rab blo 'phel gyi dbang khrid snang gsal sgron ma
item.coloph: zhes mkha' 'gro shes rab blo 'phel dbang khrid 'di/ shin tu gsang dgos pa zhig yin yang / dam ldan dge rgan rin chen gyis yang yang bskul ngor/ dbra btsun shes rab dgongs rgyal gyis mkha' 'gro'i bka' rgya bkrol te spel ba'o/ nyes 'gal ma lus mkha' 'gro'i sku la bshags/ dge rtsa thams cad mkha' mnyam 'gro la bsngo/ gong du rjes gnang rung dka' ba zhes bya ba sa glang lor/ zhe sdang sbrul bzhin me chen la/ dam nyams shing bsnan yong ba'i rkyen/ snyan rgyud me'i tshig ste song / da lta lung 'gag song nges 'dug bdag la dran 'os med nges yin/ dam ldan ma gtogs gzhan la gsang rgya gab rgya sbas rgya
